KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kuandika 2.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki ya Kutoa Mwaliko.

2. When practising Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.
